summary: The VPS already holds a deep, well-structured evidence base usable for a pre-Q00 OBSERVE/DISCOVER research layer, but has no dedicated "experiment memory" or "search-history" ledger yet. The authority is farm_state.sqlite (1.26 GB, 37 tables + 2 views): work_items (149,094 rows) is the central run record carrying phase, ea_id, symbol, verdict, evidence_path, data_window, and a verdict_taxonomy that cleanly separates INFRA failure (56,044) from economic/strategy outcomes (53,752) and measurements (19,962); ea_metrics (100,110) is the normalized numeric projection. Verdict-taxonomy classification is canonical in tools/strategy_farm/work_item_clean_view.py (exposed as the read-only work_items_clean TEMP view). Parameter-sweep memory already exists as OPT_CENSUS (34,342 rows / DL-089) and WINDOW_SWEEP surfaces; per-run evidence lives under D:/QM/reports/work_items as 45,008 gzipped summary.json/report.htm trees. The strongest precedent for an additive ledger is D:/QM/reports/state/tester_memory_ledger.jsonl (append-only JSONL, schema-versioned) and the qm.dsr-cohort/v1 schema which already defines a search_history field. The research Python env is bare: numpy 2.4.6 only; pandas/scipy/sklearn/statsmodels/duckdb/polars/pyarrow/lightgbm/xgboost all missing, though uv 0.11.7 is present to build an isolated venv. Resources are adequate (63 GB RAM / 50 free; D: 65.6 GB free but below the 150 GB purge line) but research must yield to MT5 workers, which self-throttle at CPU 97%/resume 90% and RAM floor 14/resume 20 GB. The additive design is a new versioned JSONL ledger plus a read-only projector under existing conventions — never a second database.

risks: D: has only 65.6 GB free (below the 150 GB purge no-op line), so an offline research job that materializes large intermediates on D: could trip the DISK_MIN_FREE_GB=40 worker floor and stall backtests; research outputs should be small JSONL/parquet and ideally land on C: or G:.

The scientific stack (pandas/scipy/duckdb/sklearn) is entirely absent from the farm python; installing into the system python risks polluting the MT5/worker runtime. Use uv (0.11.7, already present) to build an isolated venv instead of pip-installing into Python311.

Re-parsing the 45,008 gzipped work_item summary/report trees at runtime is expensive and competes with worker I/O; a research layer must read the sqlite (mode=ro) + ea_metrics table + JSONL ledgers, not walk the gzip trees on every run.

verdict vs verdict_taxonomy must not be conflated: a MEASURED OPT_CENSUS row is taxonomy 'measurement' (deliberately DISJOINT from 'strategy'), so counting economic failures must filter taxonomy='strategy' or use the work_items_clean view, or the 56k INFRA_FAIL and 20k measurement rows will pollute 'which ideas failed' aggregates.
14,418 work_items have NULL verdict_taxonomy and 3,833 have NULL verdict (open/pending/legacy); any idea-outcome projection must handle these as 'open/unknown', not silently drop or miscount them.

WINDOW_SWEEP_OWNER work_items carry verdict DECLARED with evidence_path=EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE (they are program declarations); the real per-cell measurements are OPT_CENSUS/backtest rows under WINSWEEP_* cell_keys — a naive join on phase would miss the actual sweep evidence.

Writing anything into farm_state.sqlite or the reports tree violates the read-only mandate and could corrupt the live factory state DB (workers hold it busy); the experiment-memory ledger must be a NEW append-only file, never a schema change to the existing DB.

A research process that ignores the worker resource latches (CPU>90% sustained, RAM<14 GB free) will directly slow MT5 saturation, the primary throughput metric; it must gate on the same thresholds and run at low priority.
unknowns: Exact byte size of the D:/QM/reports/work_items tree: du -sm timed out at 90s over 45,008 dirs; it is the dominant consumer of D: but the precise figure is UNVERIFIED.

Whether candidate_qualifications (schema present, 0 rows currently) is actively populated by the current pipeline or is a staged/empty table — could not confirm live write path in the read-only window.

The full reason_classes vocabulary (the economic-vs-infra sub-reasons inside summary.json, e.g. MIN_TRADES_NOT_MET) was sampled but not exhaustively enumerated; a complete controlled vocabulary would require scanning the gzip summaries or the classifier source.
Whether a uv-built research venv on this VPS can resolve pandas/duckdb wheels offline or needs network egress (not tested; installing is outside the read-only mandate).
Current live CPU load and how many MT5 workers are active right now (RAM was 50 GB free implying light load, but instantaneous CPU headroom for research was not measured).

integration_points.what: A new schema-versioned JSONL ledger (schema 'qm.experiment_memory/v1') mirroring the tester_memory_ledger.jsonl convention: one line per idea/experiment observation with {schema, ts_utc, strategy_id, ea_id, symbol, timeframe, phase, hypothesis, verdict, verdict_taxonomy, reason, evidence_path, work_item_id}. Additive, no DB change.
integration_points.why: tester_memory_ledger.jsonl already proves this exact pattern (append-only JSONL under reports/state, schema field, written incrementally); reusing it avoids a second database and stays inside the read-only/additive convention.

integration_points.what: A read-only projector tool that SELECTs from work_items_clean + ea_metrics + work_item_holds + work_item_transition_ledger + poison_pill_quarantine and emits a versioned 'which ideas failed and why' projection JSON, joined idea->ea via ea_id_registry.csv.
integration_points.why: ea_metrics.py and mission_control_v2_data.py already establish the read-only projector pattern (rebuildable derived JSON under reports/state); this fills the missing idea-grain, INFRA-vs-economic-aware failure view without new storage.

integration_points.what: Reuse the already-defined search_history / research_trial_count concept as the canonical shape for pre-Q00 search history, and reference sealed cohort search_history from the experiment-memory ledger rather than inventing a parallel trial-count model.
integration_points.why: The multiple-testing search-history vocabulary already exists and is schema-enforced; a DISCOVER layer should extend it, not duplicate it, to keep DSR trial accounting consistent.

integration_points.where: work_items.phase token space (as OPT_CENSUS / WINDOW_SWEEP_OWNER already do)
integration_points.what: If OBSERVE/DISCOVER runs need to be recorded as farm work, use a new non-gate phase token with measurement/measurement-only taxonomy (never 'strategy'), exactly how OPT_CENSUS sits beside the Qxx gates.
integration_points.why: The schema already tolerates research phases outside Q00-Q17 with their own taxonomy kept DISJOINT from the gate funnel (work_item_clean_view.py), so a pre-Q00 layer can be represented without corrupting gate counts.

integration_points.what: Feed the OBSERVE/DISCOVER layer from the existing sources provenance table (118 rows, uri/lane/status/notes_path) and the research_strategy agent-task lane rather than a new intake store.
integration_points.why: Research-source provenance and the throttled research lane already exist; the DISCOVER layer should consume them, keeping the '<5 ready cards' research throttle intact.

integration_points.what: Provision pandas/duckdb/scipy in a uv-managed venv separate from Python311, and read the sqlite in mode=ro; do not pip-install into the farm/system python.
integration_points.why: The system python is the MT5 worker runtime (metatrader5 module) and must stay untouched; uv is already present to isolate research dependencies.
